subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures for assessing compliance with legal requirements and privacy policies are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CA-2 (Control Assessments), PM-6 (Measures of Performance)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.35 (Independent review), Clause 9.2 (Internal audit)
implementation_examples: Establish and maintain policies, processes, and procedures for assessing compliance with legal requirements and internal privacy policies
Schedule recurring internal compliance reviews, and consider independent external assurance where appropriate
Track compliance findings and remediation actions to closure
assessment_objectives: Determine whether internal and/or external audits are scheduled and executed
Determine whether compliance findings are tracked to closure
Determine whether compliance posture is reported to leadership
